dataset: Arabidopsis vegetative shoot apex single-cell atlas
accession: BioProject PRJCA003094; Beijing Institute of Genomics Data Center
object_used: Annotated Arabidopsis shoot Seurat object; tissue_col = tissue; reduction = umap; used for ath-miR399.
notes: Source: Zhang et al. 2021, Developmental Cell, DOI 10.1016/j.devcel.2021.02.021. Dataset reported 36,643 high-quality cells, 23 transcriptionally distinct clusters and 7 broad populations.

dataset: Arabidopsis root developmental landscape single-cell atlas
accession: NCBI SRA BioProject PRJNA517021; root atlas web server reported by source paper
object_used: Annotated Arabidopsis root Seurat object; tissue_col = tissue; reduction = umap; used for ath-miR399 and ath-miR165/166.
notes: Source: Zhang et al. 2019, Molecular Plant, DOI 10.1016/j.molp.2019.04.004. Dataset reported 7,695 cells, 23,161 genes and 24 putative root cell clusters.

dataset: Rice single-cell multi-omics atlas, crown root subset
accession: NCBI GEO GSE232863, GSE273875 and GSE245410; GSE232863 scRNA object used for PhytomiRAct.
object_used: Rice_root object derived from GSE232863_scRNA_omics.Rds; root-derived cells selected and reanalysed/re-embedded; tissue_col = tissue; reduction = root_umap.
notes: Source: Wang et al. 2025, Nature, DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-09251-0. Original atlas profiled 116,564 nuclei from eight organs; crown root contained 31,108 nuclei.

dataset: Maize root tip single-cell RNA-seq nitrate-response atlas
object_used: Maize_control object; nitrate-minus/control cells retained; tissue_col = tissue derived from Celltype metadata; reduction = umap.
notes: Source: Li et al. 2022, The Crop Journal, DOI 10.1016/j.cj.2022.02.004. Original dataset profiled >7,000 cells from maize seedling root tips and identified 11 major cell types/tissues.
